a.lede: A pair of unsecured databases exposed sensitive information about hundreds of millions of people—including data that could let attackers “own” a victim’s digital life.
a.title: Database Leaks Expose 3.5 Billion Usernames, Passwords, and Documents

b.lede: 1Password assures customers that their logins and other sensitive information were not compromised in a recent data breach.
b.title: 1Password says it was hacked but users' vaults are safe
